note: The round-bundle red herring no longer ends anywhere: its payoff and description leave the bundle a mystery.

patch.value: Roz points out that Finn was the only visitor on Gull Rock and needs money for his boat. Behind Ada's coal box sits a round, blanket-wrapped bundle as wide as the lens. Once Finn trusts the investigator, he admits it is a wooden birthday sign he carved for Ada.
Roz points out that Finn was the only visitor on Gull Rock and needs money for his boat. Behind Ada's coal box sits a round, blanket-wrapped bundle as wide as the lens. Finn will not say what it is.
The bundle is Finn's birthday sign for Ada, not the lens, so the false lead against Finn is disproved.
The bundle stays a mystery: nobody ever finds out what is inside.
